Validation_Type.reason: Confirmed. ADNI and NACC are each run separately. Every method is trained on a random 80% of patients and tested on the held-out 20%, over ten random splits (Table 1 reports mean +/- SD over ten runs). There is no external site, since neither dataset tests a model trained on the other. V2 requires 'no separate test set', which the paper contradicts. The template's note assigns a train/test split without an external site to V3, and the normalisation rules list an explicit 80/20 split as V3. No validation set or tuning procedure is described. The repeated random hold-out resembles Monte Carlo cross-validation, but the definitions map a patient-level train/test split to V3, not V2.
Validation_Type.quote: We evaluated all the methods on ten different randomly generated training and test splits. The number of patients selected for training was 80% of the total number of patients, while 20% were used for testing.
Validation_Type.supporting_quote: The experiments were performed on ADNI and NACC datasets separately

Sample_N_Approx.reason: Confirmed. Models are trained and evaluated only on patients with at least seven visits: 250 ADNI + 1,414 NACC = 1,664. 1,169 is the ADNI count after preprocessing, before the seven-visit restriction. It never enters training or evaluation, and it leaves out NACC, which is analysed in every experiment. It matches no study-level total: analysed 1,664; post-preprocessing 1,169 + 8,121 = 9,290; source 2,288 + 46,513 = 48,801. It is not an enrolled-vs-analysed or discovery-vs-validation alternative of the kind the defensible clause covers, and even for ADNI alone the analysed N is 250.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: Finally, we focused on patients with at least seven visits for training and model evaluation. This resulted in a final ADNI dataset of 20 longitudinal features for 250 patients and a final NACC dataset with 5 longitudinal features for 1,414 patients.
Sample_N_Approx.supporting_quote: After preprocessing, the dataset had 20 longitudinal features for 1,169 patients across 5,759 visits, derived from cognitive performance tests and MRI scans.
